# Activity cursor
`page(records, cursor=None, limit=10)` sorts records by `(timestamp, id)`
ascending and returns `{"items": list, "next_cursor": cursor_or_None}`.
Timestamps are ISO UTC strings; ids are unique strings. A returned cursor
may be passed unchanged to the next call. Pages do not repeat or skip a
record, even when timestamps tie. `next_cursor` is None after the last
page. `limit` must be positive. The caller may supply records in any order.
Each page contains exactly the next min(limit, remaining-record-count) records
in that order. Return a non-None continuation precisely when records remain;
return None on a terminal page, including when its size equals limit.

import json
from activity.store import sample
from activity.paging import page

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps(page(sample(), limit=2)))
